children: Tyler joined the board as a non‑executive director in April 2025 and became interim chair in May 2026.
BP highlighted that Tyler has worked with more than 15 chief executives during a long non‑executive career across listed and private companies in oil and gas, natural resources and engineering.
He currently chairs Grafton Group and serves as senior independent director at Anglo American, and has previously chaired Cairn Energy and served as a non‑executive director at BAE Systems.

Senior independent director Amanda Blanc said: "I am delighted that the board has unanimously appointed Ian Tyler as chair of BP. Ian brings significant experience providing challenge and support to executive teams, while maintaining strong governance and oversight on behalf of shareholders.

"These qualities have been evident during his time as interim chair, where he has secured the confidence of the board and executive management through his considered leadership, judgement and integrity."
As of 0830 BST, BP shares were up 0.30% at 542.90p.
Reporting by Iain Gilbert at Sharecast.com
